tooltips.stage: This field is deprecated. Please use the 'Stage' link field instead, which allows custom stages.
tooltips.status: The current status of the opportunity. Automatically set based on the stage's probability (0 = Lost, 100 = Won, other = Open).
tooltips.followupStatus: The current follow-up workflow state. Set by the user and automatically flipped to 'Ended' when the opportunity is Won or Lost.
tooltips.followupTimer: The earliest moment the AI is allowed to send the next follow-up message on this opportunity. Cleared automatically when the follow-up status leaves 'Waiting Reply'.
tooltips.followupCount: Number of consecutive follow-ups sent without receiving a reply. Resets to 0 whenever the follow-up status leaves 'Waiting Reply'.
tooltips.followupBreakoutLimit: Maximum number of consecutive follow-ups the AI may send before it must stop contacting the prospect. Acts as a per-deal safety net. Leave empty to inherit the driving AI agent's default (or 3 when it has none); a value set here — by the AI or via mass-update — always wins over the agent default.
tooltips.followupAiAgent: The AI agent currently driving this opportunity's follow-up loop. NULL when the loop is operator-driven or inactive.
tooltips.funnel: The sales funnel this opportunity belongs to. Stages will be filtered based on the selected funnel.
tooltips.opportunityStage: The current stage of this opportunity. Stages are filtered by the selected funnel.
tooltips.sourceChannel: The acquisition channel that originated this opportunity. Set once at creation (first touch) and never overwritten.
tooltips.sourceTargetList: The outreach batch (Target List) that originated this opportunity. Only set for Outbound opportunities, at creation time.
tooltips.customFields: Tenant-defined custom attributes. Values follow this record's ACL.

messages.stageDeprecated: The enum 'Stage' field has been replaced with a link to OpportunityStage. This allows custom stages with different probabilities and styles.
